boardCards.name: The Mayor
boardCards.text:
Starts With 3 Happiness Counter
Once per turn you may spend one Happiness Counter to do one of the following:
 - Add 1 Gold
 - Draw 1 card
 - Deal 2 {damage}

Once per turn you may discard a card, pay 1 gold and add 1 omen to add a happiness counter.

**If this reaches 0 Happiness Counters, you lose the game**

faces.text:
Do one of the following:
 - Remove 2 happiness counter from {card:the-mayor-of-havens-rest/the-mayor}, each player draws a card
 - Add 1 happiness counter, a player discards a card
Remove 1 happiness counter from the mayor unless the players collectively pay 1{gold}{perPlayer}
For each district on fire remove 1 happiness counter from {card:the-mayor-of-havens-rest/the-mayor} (To a maximum of 3)

entityCards.name: Havens' Under Table Dealings
entityCards.flavour: Not all those that lurk in the darkest corners of Havens Rest help with no cost.
